records41_42.identity: Once-weekly recombinant single-chain insulin analog/IgG2 Fc homodimer from CHO cells, supplied in 500 and 1,000 units/mL subcutaneous 3 mL prefilled pens. The catalog insulin efsitora alfa record requires suffix-aware product identity review; no automatic product merge is claimed.
records41_42.moa: Insulin receptor activity regulates glucose: peripheral uptake including skeletal muscle and fat, inhibition of hepatic glucose production, inhibition of lipolysis and proteolysis, and enhanced protein synthesis. Protracted action is linked to molecular size, neonatal Fc receptor binding, and reduced insulin receptor affinity and clearance. These mechanisms do not establish muscle force gain.
records41_42.indication: Adjunct to diet and exercise for glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes. The label does not recommend use in type 1 diabetes because of severe hypoglycemia risk.
records41_42.safety: Medication, frequency and dose errors can cause serious hypoglycemia with prolonged recovery. Sponsor PI section 5.2 reports severe hypoglycemia in 10% versus 3% with degludec in a 52-week type 1 trial. Other section 5 warnings cover regimen changes, hypersensitivity, hypokalemia, pen sharing, and fluid retention or heart failure with PPAR-gamma agonists.
records41_42.label_trial_endpoints: Four randomized, open-label, active-controlled QWINT trials in type 2 diabetes. Label section 14 reports HbA1c, fasting glucose, time in glucose range and insulin dose. No motor, force or task benefit is reported in this section. HbA1c noninferiority does not establish functional efficacy.
records41_42.official_label_access: Drugs@FDA BLA 761408 explicitly states that the label is not available on this site. Guessed FDA Orig1s000 and s000 PDF URLs returned 404. Official approval letter, news and application are saved. Sponsor-hosted PI was read with distinct provenance.

records41_42.identity: Oral lirafugratinib hydrochloride capsules: 20 mg active moiety corresponds to 21.43 mg salt; 30 mg corresponds to 32.15 mg salt. The catalog groups CHEMBL5314555 and CHEMBL5314556. Preserve the administered salt and active-moiety distinction.
records41_42.moa: Covalent FGFR2 small-molecule kinase inhibitor. The label describes inhibition of phosphorylation, downstream signaling and cancer-cell viability with FGFR2 alterations, plus xenograft anti-tumor activity. This cancer mechanism does not establish BUB1B rescue or physiological force benefit.
records41_42.indication: Adults with previously treated unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic cholangiocarcinoma harboring an FGFR2 fusion or other rearrangement.
records41_42.safety: Section 5 reports ocular toxicity, including retinal pigment epithelial detachment in 31% of 385 monitored patients (Grade 2: 12%; Grade 3: 1.8%), blurred vision, dry eye and corneal toxicity. Hyperphosphatemia occurred in 21%; soft tissue mineralization and embryo-fetal harm or pregnancy loss are warnings. The 385-person safety denominator differs from the 116-person efficacy cohort.
records41_42.label_trial_endpoints: REFOCUS (RLY-4008-101; NCT04526106) was an open-label, single-arm trial in 116 previously treated, FGFR-inhibitor-naive patients receiving 70 mg daily. Independent RECIST v1.1 response assessment gave ORR 46% (95% CI 36–55), with 3 complete and 50 partial responses; median duration of response was 11.8 months (7.5–13.0). ECOG 0/1 was a baseline characteristic, not a measured treatment function outcome.
